## Public repository privacy checklist

- [ ] Every fixture and example was authored from scratch and is fully synthetic.
- [ ] No real insurance, medical, claim, identity, or family document is included.
- [ ] No text, image, OCR result, embedding, or metadata derived from a real document is included.
- [ ] No secret, token, password, personal identifier, Drive ID, policy number, or real path is included.
- [ ] Logs and captured errors are sanitized and contain no sensitive inputs.
- [ ] Tests and generated-contract checks relevant to this change are listed above.
- [ ] Checks that require inaccessible external systems or real devices are reported below as unverified.
